title: Diagnosis of GABHS Tonsillitis - Comparison Between Culture From Tonsills and Culture From the Bucal Surface
brief_summary:
Diagnosis of Group A beta hemolytic strep tonsillitis -

* cultre of tonsills (gold standard)
* culture from bucal surface (test)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* tonsills exudates
* Centor criteria - 2 or more

Exclusion Criteria:

* tonsillectomy
